quotes.text: D188140 reviewed a helper copied from NSS certutil. The old name DecodeECParams reflected the original command line parser, but Thunderbird’s function encodes a curve object identifier. The reviewer asked for GetECParams or EncodeECParams; the landed and current code use EncodeECParams. When adapting copied code, name helpers for the behavior in this file, rather than retaining a historical source name that reverses the operation.
